title: The Elder Kiln
start: Talk to TzHaar-Mej-Jeh at the TzHaar Birthing Pool.

items.t: Adamant pickaxe (or better), or a melee weapon if the pickaxe is on the tool belt.
Melee, magic or ranged armour, weapons, potions, and food.
Necromancy does not work on TokTz-Ket-Dill.
A dwarf multicannon is not allowed in all encounters.
Summoning familiars are not allowed in last encounter.

rewards.t: 100000 Combat XP lamp in one of: Attack, Strength, Defence, Magic or Ranged (Skill must be level 75 or higher; can be reobtained after destroying - speak to TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the main plaza)
A Tokkul-Zo, which increases damage to TzHaar, lava, and obsidian monsters, while also allowing teleportation around TzHaar City
The title TitleAnchor | t=Yt'Haar- | c=#C12006 | loc=p | space=no | link=Yt'Haar , meaning "sacred-cold" or "human"
A random amount of tokkul, up to 98 (whatever is left from the scale puzzle).

steps.t: Talk to TzHaar-Mej-Jeh at the Birthing Pool in TzHaar City. [Chat: Accept]
Keep the gauge within the two arrows using fire spells to heat it and water spells to cool it until the egg hatches.

sub.t: The two TzHaar will also fire occasionally. Keep an eye on them as both may shoot fire spells at the egg simultaneously which could result in overheating.

steps.t: Talk to TzHaar-Mej-Jeh. [Chat: 1 What's a Ga'al? › 2 Why do you do this? › 1 Can't you teach them your ways?]
Go west to the main plaza and talk to TzHaar-Mej-Ak. [Chat: 1 I've come for that Ga'al. › 1 Yes.]
Kill all enemies in the Fight Pits whilst protecting Ga'al-Jeh.
p: The battle in the Fight Pit

steps.t: After the cutscene, kill TzHaar-Ket-Yit'tal.
Talk to one of the TzHaar-Mejs. [Chat: 1 It's the remains of your dead that you use as currency. › 2 Of course I'll help the TzHaar. › 2 Okay. › 3 I had better be on my way.]
Head east of the plaza to the kiln.
Enter the cave. [Chat: 2 Yes, follow me.]
Jump the chasm [Chat: 1 Come on, Xox!] and kill all of the monsters.

sub.t: Do not use protection prayers until the TokTz-Ket-Dill's shell is broken as this will increase the frequency of making the rocks fall on you, dealing over 1,000 damage.
You need a pickaxe to break the shell of TokTz-Ket-Dill, which is weak against water spell after its shell is broken. Necromancy will not work against him.

steps.t: Investigate the skeleton at the end of the cavern [Chat: 1 Reach in and take the book.] to receive Journal of Perjour.
Proceed to the next room.
Take the TokKul on the ground and kill all of the monsters.
Proceed to the next room.
Kill all of the monsters and examine the note in the Journal of Perjour (the book which should be in your backpack). [Chat: 2 Read the note.]

For the left scale, use the picture to find its resulting sum and put that much tokkul on it. Repeat for the right scale. A Tzhaar number symbol can be higher than 15 that is shown in the picture of this guide on the right.
Proceed to the next room.
Go through the room, jumping over chasms and killing the TokTz-Ket-Dill along the way.
Proceed to the next room.
p: Tzhaar numbers for the Ancient Scales calculations

steps.t: Kill the monsters in this room.
Proceed to the next room. [Chat: 1 I'm ready.]
Complete all seven waves of the Kiln.
Talk to TokHaar-Hok. [Chat: 2 Let's see what rock you're forged from, then. › 5 I need your help. › 2 I think he should, so the Ga'al can live good lives.]
p: Using a safespot against the monsters in the Kiln.

steps.t: Proceed back through the caves, ignoring monsters along the way.

sub.t: Teleporting away and attempting to avoid heading back through the caves will result in the player being forced to return where Ga'al Xox was left at the kiln, then head back through the caves as originally intended.

p: TokHaar-Hur, level 100 – melee, weak against water spells
TokHaar-Ket, level 180 – melee, weak against water spells
TokHaar-Xil, level 140 – ranged, weak against crush
TokHaar-Mej, level 160 – magic, but will hit melee at close range, weak against bolts
TokHaar-Ket Champion, level 105 – melee, will periodically drain prayer points, no weakness

steps.t: Return to the centre of the Main Plaza and talk to one of TzHaar-Mejs. [Chat: 1 Even after all we've done, you can't trust the Ga'al? › 2 [Let Ga'al-Xox fight] › 3 I'm only interested in the power of that Kiln.]
p: It may be possible to line your opponents up in a row.

steps.t: Quest complete!
